title: Neural Bubble Portrait
description: A surreal portrait of a young person with glowing golden eyes enclosed inside a transparent spherical bubble. Vibrant neon neural network patterns in purple, pink, and blue emanate from their face and connect to the bubble's surface, with colorful paint-like drips running down their face. The background features a stylized mountain landscape with pine trees under a dramatic twilight sky, intersected by glowing geometric pathways.
